title: Free-Look Period Schedule for Ashgrove Income Annuity Contracts
content:
Free-look periods of Income Annuities, in calendar days from the contract delivery date, are the same on every tier — Ashgrove Income Annuity Life Only, Cash Refund, 10-Year Certain, 20-Year Certain, Joint 50% Survivor and Joint 100% Survivor.

| Period | Figure |
|---|---|
| Free-look period | 10 calendar days |
| Free-look period when the purchase replaced another annuity | 30 calendar days |
| Owner age on the issue date at or above which the senior free-look period applies | 60 |
| Senior free-look period | 30 calendar days |

Senior age boundary (hypothetical owners): an owner aged 60 on the issue date is at the senior free-look age; an owner aged 59 is below it.
